non_goals: No non-FOSS or proprietary dependencies without explicit OSI/FSF licensing declarations and clear layer isolation.
Do not expand standalone MiOS-AI runtime features or LLM gateways ahead of core desktop OS substrate and bootc lifecycle stabilization.
Do not break bootc/Fedora immutable workstation invariants (USR-OVER-ETC, persistent /var, UKI boot chain, driverless host passthrough).
Do not regress standing legibility ratchets (tracked_files <= 3071, tracked_mb <= 204, tooling_python_lines <= 77019).
Do not bypass two-sided verification (positive AND negative controls) on any dev-loop task.
